notes.title: The Match! Update
notes.notes:
Hello Lighthouse Keepers,

It’s been a while since our last update, but we’ve been hard at work behind the scenes! Today, we’re excited to share a new patch. While it doesn’t overhaul any major systems, we believe these changes will make your experience even more enjoyable. Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] Subtitles are now available for all the existing audio languages!
[*] Updated controller visuals in the tutorials.
[*] Various minor bug fixes for a smoother experience.
[/list]
And now, something many of you have requested...
[list]
[*] We’ve reworked the Chap4 puzzle! Based on your feedback, we aimed to strike a balance—keeping the unique gameplay twist while making it feel fairer and satisfying to solve. Moving around the match in the lighthouse’s confined space still offers a bit of challenge, but we’re confident the puzzle is now more intuitive and a more rewarding part of your journey.
[/list]
We hope you enjoy these updates and make sure to keep your lights shining bright!

notes.title: Spanish Language & UI update!
notes.notes:
Ahoy! We've updated to Version 1.064, in which we've added a Spanish (Latin-American) voiceover track and UI, as well as Korean UI.

Please stay safe and enjoy!

notes.title: Reel in the Headsets & Controller update!
notes.notes:
Thanks to the development of the Quest version, the InnerspaceVR devs took the various improvements in handling and controls, and implemented them into the existing PC platforms as well! 

For those curious, we have a preview of the incoming update, which also includes additional headset and controller support. We will be casting out these changes across various PC platforms in the next few days, thanks for your patience!


[b]The Patch Notes:[/b]

[b]Steam :[/b]

[u]Content:[/u]
Complete redesign of collision system and object handling
Minor fixes on navigation system and UI 
And... toothpaste on the toothbrush!

[u]Hardware support:[/u]
[list]
[*]Full support of Valve Index
[*]Full support of HTC Vive Cosmos
[*]Full support of Oculus Rift S
[*]Support of New 'Steam VR Input system' (including user-custom controller bindings)  
[/list]

Thank for your continued support of A Fisherman's Tale; it was recently a VR Game of the Year Award winner at the VR Awards! It means a lot to us.
